temeraire.story: From a real photograph of Turner's painting in its gilded museum frame, approach the 90.7 × 121.6 cm canvas, enter the painted story of the pale veteran ship and black steam tug, then return to the same authentic gallery photograph. No fictional room or animated vessel.

scenes.intent: MUSEUM: actual gilded Turner frame and painting already visible on first frame; branded opening with real art
MUSEUM: approach the real frame; discover the ghostlike ship and tiny black tug within seven seconds
Authentic pale Temeraire dominates: a farewell to the era of sail
Small dark steam tug reveals the paradox of who controls the final voyage
Black smoke rises between the pale masts, separating the two ages
Sunset warms the river and gives the farewell a poetic dimension
The delicate moon offers a pause before the historical revelation
River reflection and buoy close the visual argument without new invented imagery
MUSEUM: return from the painting into the same authentic gilded frame and patterned wall
MUSEUM: final full gallery view restores physical size of the 90.7 by 121.6 cm painting
